en:
Fwahahaha!
Welcome to my hideout!\pIt shall be so until I can restore
TEAM ROCKET to its former glory.\pBut, you have found me again.
So be it.\lThis time, I'm not holding back!\pOnce more, you shall face
GIOVANNI, the greatest TRAINER!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_ROCKET}
Ha!\nThat was a truly intense fight.\lYou have won!\pAs proof, here is the EARTHBADGE!\n{PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_OBTAIN_BADGE}{PAUSE 0xFE}{PAUSE 0x56}{RESUME_MUSIC}

Having lost in this fashion, 
I can't face my followers.\lI have betrayed their trust.\pAs of today, TEAM ROCKET is
finished forever!\pAs for myself, I shall dedicate
my life to training again.\pLet us meet again someday!
Farewell!

The EARTHBADGE makes POKéMON of
any level obey without question.\pIt is evidence of your mastery as
a POKéMON TRAINER.\pWith it, you can challenge the
POKéMON LEAGUE.\pAlso, take this TM.\pConsider it a gift for your POKéMON
LEAGUE challenge.
{PLAYER} received TM26\nfrom GIOVANNI.
TM26 contains EARTHQUAKE.\pIt is a powerful attack that causes\na massive tremor.\pI made it when I ran the GYM here,\nfar too long ago…
You do not have space for this!
Heh!\nYou must be running out of steam\lby now!
I ran out of gas!
You'll need power to keep up with\nour GYM LEADER.
Rrrroar!\nI'm working myself into a rage!
Wargh!
I'm still not worthy!
POKéMON and I, we make wonderful\nmusic together!
You are in perfect harmony!
Do you know the identity of our\nGYM LEADER?
Karate is the ultimate form of\nmartial arts!
Aiyah!
If my POKéMON were as good at\nkarate as I…
The truly talented win with style.
I lost my grip!
The LEADER will scold me for\nlosing this way…
I'm the KARATE KING!\nYour fate rests with me!
Ayah!
The POKéMON LEAGUE?\nYou? Don't get cocky!
Your POKéMON will cower at the\ncrack of my whip!
Yowch!\nWhiplash!
Wait!\nI was just careless!
VIRIDIAN GYM was closed for a\nlong time.\pBut now, our LEADER is back!
I was beaten?
You can go on to the POKéMON\nLEAGUE only by defeating our GYM\lLEADER!

Yo!
Champ in the making!\pEven I don't know the VIRIDIAN
LEADER's identity.\pBut one thing's certain.
This will be the toughest of all\lthe GYM LEADERS.\pAlso, I heard that the TRAINERS
here like GROUND-type POKéMON.
Blow me away! GIOVANNI was the\nGYM LEADER of VIRIDIAN?
VIRIDIAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ?\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}
VIRIDIAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: GIOVANNI\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}
